name: Elite
strategy: Improve existing Units through Accurate, Critical, Tough, Brace, and suppression of defensive reroll keywords, without broadly increasing Attack dice.

commands.name: Veteran Spearhead
commands.effect: If the active Unit has an Elite tag, its next Melee Attack this Combat Phase gains Critical 1 without requiring a Surge.

commands.name: Find the Opening
commands.effect: The active Unit gains Accurate 2 on its next Attack this Phase.

commands.name: Perfect Technique
commands.effect: The active Unit gains Accurate 1 on its next Attack this Phase. Against that Attack, reduce the defender's effective Tough X and Cover X by 2 each, minimum zero. Suppressing Cover rerolls does not remove Cover-granted Evade eligibility.

commands.name: Combat Training
commands.effect: The active Unit gains Tough 1 and Brace 1 until the end of the Round.

commands.name: Knightly Order
commands.effect: When the active Unit declares its next Charge this Assault Phase, it gains Charge 1 and Impact +1 for that Charge. Charge ranks use the highest rank unless explicitly additive.

doctrineIdentity: Disciplined, keyword-focused precision and defense; unlike Gambit, Elite does not use Reckless for additional Attack volume.
